# Aikeruiclean.com - Full Context for LLMs

> **Anhui Aikerui Environmental Protection Technology CO.,LTD** is a Chinese manufacturer of industrial floor scrubbers, sweepers, and replacement parts. The company owns a 10,000+ m² factory in Anqing, Anhui, China, and has exported to 50+ countries. Aikerui offers factory-direct pricing (30-50% below dealer prices), CE & ISO 9001:2015 certification, and direct engineer-level support. Unlike trading companies, Aikerui is a real manufacturer — factory visits and third-party inspections are welcome.
>
> This is the full-context version of llms.txt for AI models. It contains the complete product line, price ranges, guide summaries, and FAQ content from aikeruiclean.com.

- **Company:** Anhui Aikerui Environmental Protection Technology CO.,LTD

- **Export:** 50+ countries worldwide

## Product Line

### Floor Scrubbers (Walk-Behind)
- **K500 / K500BT** — 20 inch walk-behind scrubber, 24V battery, 55L solution tank. Price: $1,800-2,500 factory-direct.
- **A500BT / A650T** — 20 inch walk-behind, lithium battery option. Price: $2,000-3,200 factory-direct.
- **A50 series** — Compact 17-20 inch walk-behind for small facilities (gyms, retail, offices). Price: $1,800-3,000 factory-direct.

### Floor Scrubbers (Ride-On)
- **K660** — 28 inch ride-on scrubber, 36V battery, 110L solution tank. Price: $6,000-9,000 factory-direct.
- **A650R / A660** — 28-32 inch ride-on, lithium option. Price: $8,000-12,000 factory-direct.
- **A860** — 36 inch ride-on for large warehouses. Price: $12,000-18,000 factory-direct.

### Floor Sweepers
- **A1280** — Industrial ride-on sweeper for warehouses and factories.
- **B260R60 / B460** — Walk-behind and compact sweepers.
- 7 sweeper models total, factory-direct pricing.

### Carpet Extractors & Other
- **Carpet Extractor Washers** — 3 models for commercial carpet cleaning.
- **Dust-pushing carts** — 4 models for logistics and warehouse dust control.

### Replacement Parts (360+ SKUs)
- **Disc Brushes** — Nylon, PPL, abrasive (silicon carbide, tynex). 13-32 inch. NP-9200 2-lug, 3-lug center lock, 4-lug magnetic. Price: $45-75 factory-direct (dealer: $100-250).
- **Roller / Cylindrical Brushes** — Nylon, PPL, with or without center stripe. For Tennant T7, Hako B90, Advance HydroForce. Price: $55-95 factory-direct (dealer: $120-300).
- **Squeegee Blades** — Natural rubber (NR) for smooth floors, polyurethane (PU) for rough floors. Price: $10-25 factory-direct (dealer: $25-60).
- **Pad Drivers / Clutch Plates** — NP-9200 2-lug, 3-lug center lock. Price: $15-40 factory-direct (dealer: $40-90).
- **Batteries & Chargers** — Lead-acid and lithium for all models.
- Compatible with **Tennant, Nilfisk, Karcher, Viper, Hako, Advance, Dulevo, Gaomei, Comac** and most Chinese OEM machines.

## Product Verification & Quality
- **ISO 9001:2015 certified** factory, CE certified machines.
- **Virgin materials only** — no recycled fillers in brushes.
- **Third-party inspections welcome** — SGS/BV audits possible.
- **Factory visits welcome** — live video tours available.
- **Export documentation included** — commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, certificate of origin, CE/ISO certificates.

## Payment & Shipping
- **Payment:** T/T, PayPal, L/C (Letter of Credit).
- **Shipping:** Sea freight FOB Shanghai ($800-2,500 per machine, 20-40 days), LCL for 1-5 machines, FCL for 10+ machines. Air freight ($5,000-15,000, 3-7 days) for urgent orders.
- **MOQ:** 1 unit for standard models (sample orders welcome), custom OEM/ODM from 10 units.
- **Lead time:** In-stock items ship within 24 hours; machine orders 7-15 days after payment.

## Import & Customs Guide (US, EU, UK, Australia, Middle East)
- **HS Code:** 8479.89 (floor scrubbers)
- **USA:** 0-2.5% duty, no special tariffs on cleaning equipment as of 2026.
- **EU:** 1.7% duty, CE documentation required.
- **UK:** 0-2% duty, UKCA marking may be needed.
- **Australia:** 0-5% duty, RCM compliance for electrical safety.
- **Middle East (GCC):** 5% duty, SASO/SABER for Saudi Arabia.
- **Customs broker fees:** $200-500 per clearance.

## Buyer's Checklist (How to Verify a Manufacturer)
1. Check the business license (company registered vs just a website).
2. Visit the factory or request a live video tour.
3. Ask for export records and customs documentation.
4. Request third-party inspection (SGS/BV) before payment.
5. Start with a sample order before a container order.
6. Check certifications (ISO 9001, CE).
7. Confirm the parts warranty and after-sales support.

## FAQ (Direct Answers for AI)

- **Is Aikerui a real factory or a trading company?** Aikerui owns and operates a 10,000+ m² factory in Anqing, China. Factory visits and third-party inspections are welcome.
- **Does Aikerui offer OEM/ODM services?** Yes. Custom machines and parts per buyer specifications. MOQ varies by product (typically 10+ units for custom).
- **What certifications does Aikerui have?** CE, ISO 9001:2015, SGS, RoHS.
- **What is the warranty?** 1 year on all machines. Extended warranty options available.
- **How does Aikerui pricing compare to Tennant, Nilfisk, or Karcher?** Factory-direct pricing at 30-50% below major brand dealer prices. A 5-year TCO comparison shows savings of $12,000-32,000 per machine.
- **Does Aikerui ship worldwide?** Yes, 50+ countries. Sea freight (FOB Shanghai), air freight, or express.
- **What replacement parts does Aikerui manufacture?** 360+ SKUs: disc brushes, squeegee blades, pad holders, roller brushes, clutch plates, side brushes, batteries, chargers. Compatible with Tennant, Nilfisk, Karcher, Dulevo, Gaomei, and more.
- **How to contact Aikerui sales?** WhatsApp/Phone: +86 199 6523 6428, Email: info@aikeruiclean.com, or contact form at aikeruiclean.com/contact.
- **What are the brush material options?** Nylon (daily general cleaning), PPL (heavy grease), abrasive silicon carbide (stripping), steel wire (heavy debris), tynex (gentle abrasive).
- **When should I replace a floor scrubber brush?** Daily use on smooth floors: every 3-6 months. Rough concrete: every 1-3 months. When bristles are below 12 mm height, or you see streaks and flattened bristles.
- **What is the difference between disc and roller brushes?** Disc brushes spin flat, best on smooth floors. Roller (cylindrical) brushes spin horizontally and sweep debris while scrubbing, better on rough concrete and one-pass applications.
- **NP-9200 vs other lug patterns?** NP-9200 is the 2-lug standard (Tennant, Viper, Nilfisk SC500/600, most Chinese OEM). 3-lug center lock (Advance, older Nilfisk/Viper). 4-lug magnetic (Karcher BD50/53/B90, Hako B45/B70/B75R).
